skill.name: douyin-content-research
skill.description: Research Douyin trends and compare keyword search results with SocialDataX. Summarize relevant posts, their sources, and ideas for follow-up.
skill.summary: Turn Douyin hot-search rankings and filtered post samples into a content research brief.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick matches are Markdown, and the Chinese text does not appear obfuscated. The CLI executes an unpinned npm package that can access configured credentials and local files. Shell argument handling, external content, and billing links need safeguards, but no exfiltration or embedded prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: The CLI runs a mutable npm release in the same environment that holds credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, exact package version and verify its integrity before execution. Require consent before installing it and give it only the credential and permissions it needs.

remediation.issue: The documented CLI search does not specify how to pass untrusted values without shell interpretation.
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and pagination cursors as separate process arguments without invoking a shell. Use a vetted MCP connection when the client cannot pass arguments safely.

remediation.issue: The CLI can read credentials from the environment or a persistent user file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a narrow-scope service credential from an OS keyring or managed secret store where available. Keep diagnostics limited to credential availability and source.

remediation.issue: Returned post text and links are not explicitly marked as untrusted.
remediation.suggestion: Treat returned titles, descriptions, and links as data only. Do not execute instructions from results or follow returned links without separate user approval.

remediation.issue: The billing workflow may surface a URL supplied in an error response.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed SocialDataX billing URL rather than a URL returned in an error. Leave payment decisions and navigation to the user.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The output guidance confirms that external text enters the analysis without an explicit trust boundary. No malicious result was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Error-Supplied Billing Link Lacks Explicit Validation
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to display a billing link from an error before using a fixed fallback. An unverified link could misdirect payment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text names the official destination but does not specify how to validate the link from the response. No malicious billing link was observed.

content.value_statement: Douyin rankings and search results are hard to compare without a clear sample. Use SocialDataX to organize current rankings, relevant posts, and follow-up questions in one brief.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current Douyin hot-search rankings without a keyword.
Search Douyin video and image posts by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP connection.
Filter posts by publication window, duration, or content type and sort by recency or likes.
Continue the same search with a page cursor and use CLI page or item limits to bound the sample.
Summarize ranked topics and post samples separately, with titles, authors, links or IDs, and metrics when available.
limitations: Live data requires a SocialDataX credential for the CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Research requests can consume service credits, and insufficient balance can interrupt retrieval.
Search results are samples, not a complete archive or a measure of total audience demand.
The research workflow cannot post, comment, like, or modify Douyin accounts.

use_cases.title: Prepare a daily trend brief
use_cases.description: Review the current ranking and identify relevant topics for the editorial calendar.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor coverage
use_cases.description: Search two brands with the same filters and compare recurring formats using traceable examples.

use_cases.title: Plan a short video
use_cases.description: Review recent videos on a topic and identify a distinct approach supported by the sample.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Check current trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top five entries on the current Douyin hot-search list. Include rank and any available popularity signal.

prompt_templates.title: Basic: Sample a topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for [topic] and stop after one page. Include titles, authors, and links or IDs when available.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Compare post formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [topic] over the past week. Compare one page of short videos with one page of image posts. Separate evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Build a competitor brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [brand A] and [brand B] using the same weekly filters and newest-first sorting. Stop after two pages per brand. Report recurring themes, source links, and sample gaps.

output_examples.input: Show the current Douyin hot-search ranking and suggest one follow-up topic.
output: Illustrative snapshot: Home workout routines rank third in this example.
Follow-up: Search for beginner home workouts to see which formats appear in recent posts.
The ranking is a current signal, not a forecast.

output_examples.input: Compare one page each of video and image posts about small-space storage.
output: Illustrative video sample: A closet reset demonstrates storage changes before and after.
Illustrative image-post sample: A drawer organizer guide uses labeled photos.
Possible content idea: Combine a short demonstration with a reference checklist. One page per format is not enough to compare overall popularity.

best_practices: Start with one page and choose a page or item limit before expanding.
Use identical filters for comparisons and include links or content IDs when available.
State the search scope and separate measured signals from your interpretation.
anti_patterns: Treating a small or partial sample as complete coverage of Douyin.
Combining keyword results and hot-search rankings as if they measure the same thing.
Pasting an API key, private query, or credential file into chat.

faq.question: What do I need for live results?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or configure a SocialDataX API key for the CLI.

faq.question: Do I need a keyword for the hot-search list?
faq.answer: No. A keyword is required only for post search.

faq.question: Can I search only for short videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Select video posts and use the under-one-minute duration filter.

faq.question: Why are some results missing?
faq.answer: The filters, service coverage, or a request error can limit the sample. Check whether the results were reported as partial.

faq.question: Can a search use service credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with a small sample and expand only when the additional results are useful.

faq.question: Can this skill change my Douyin account?
faq.answer: No. It does not log into Douyin, publish posts, like posts, or leave comments.
